title: crataegus oxyacantha var. acutiloba
intro: Crataegus oxyacantha var. acutiloba, commonly known as the Hawthorn, is a deciduous shrub or small tree belonging to the Rosaceae family. The health benefits of Crataegus oxyacantha var. acutiloba include its ability to reduce blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and depression. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its vasodilatory effects, antioxidant properties, and potential anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Crataegus oxyacantha var. acutiloba include flavonoids, such as quercetin and epicatechin, as well as oligomeric proanthocyanidins (OPCs), which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
